On-device text recognition for Debt Slayer. These files stay on this site.
The browser loads them only after you open Update from screenshot. No image
or recognized text is sent to a server.

- tesseract.min.js and worker.min.js: tesseract.js 5.1.1, Apache License 2.0.
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js: tesseract.js-core 5.1.1, Apache License 2.0.
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- eng.traineddata.gz: Tesseract fast English model (4.0.0_fast), Apache License 2.0.
  https://github.com/naptha/tessdata/tree/gh-pages/4.0.0_fast

The Apache License 2.0 text is in LICENSE in this folder.
